name: Settle Stomach
body:
School conjuration (healing); Level cleric/oracle 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one living creature
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

Settle stomach ends a nauseated condition for the creature touched. The target cannot be affected again by the same thing that initially nauseated them for 24 hours.
